question.problem: Find the angle between $a=⟨1,-1,0⟩$ and $b=⟨0,1,-2⟩.$ Round your answer to $1$ decimal place.
question.worked_solution:
Rearranging the dot product formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,a\,||\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 0+(-1)\cdot 1+0\cdot (-2)}{\sqrt{{1}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+{0}^{2}}\sqrt{{0}^{2}+{1}^{2}+(-2)^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{-1}{\sqrt{2}\cdot \sqrt{5}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\theta =\operatorname{arccos}⁡(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}})≈{108.4}^{∘}.
$$
